source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
When this unit finishes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), you may pick 1 enemy unit that is **visible** to it and no more than 12" away, and roll a D6. A 3+ deals D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** to that enemy unit.

Each unit may use this ability once per turn and twice per battle: place 2 Bomb Squig tokens beside the unit and remove 1 per use.
